mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_SURVEY_TB (MBS_ID , MB_ID , MBS_SCORE , MBS_SERVEY_DATE , MBS_WRITER_ID , MBS_REG_DATE) VALUES ((SELECT NVL(MAX(MBS_ID)+1, 1) FROM MEMBER_SURVEY_TB) , #{mb_id} , #{mbs_score} , SYSDATE , #{mb_id} , SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM MEMBER_SURVEY_TB WHERE MBS_ID = (SELECT MAX(MBS_ID) FROM MEMBER_SURVEY_TB mst WHERE mst.MB_ID = #{sessionID})

WITH SPLIT_PILL AS ( SELECT MB_ID, MBP_ID, REGEXP_SUBSTR(MBP_INT_PILL, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) AS PILL FROM MEMBER_PROFILE_TB WHERE MB_ID = #{sessionID} CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(MBP_INT_PILL, ',') + 1 AND PRIOR MBP_ID = MBP_ID AND PRIOR SYS_GUID() IS NOT NULL ), SPLIT_RULE AS ( SELECT RULE_ID, RULE_INTEREST, TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(RULE_RECOMMEND, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS RECOMMEND FROM RULE_TB CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(RULE_RECOMMEND, ',') + 1 AND PRIOR RULE_ID = RULE_ID AND PRIOR SYS_GUID() IS NOT NULL ), RECOMMEND_JOIN AS ( SELECT DISTINCT P.MB_ID, P.MBP_ID, R.RECOMMEND FROM SPLIT_PILL P JOIN SPLIT_RULE R ON P.PILL = R.RULE_INTEREST WHERE R.RECOMMEND IS NOT NULL ), LIMITED_RECOMMEND AS ( SELECT MB_ID, MBP_ID, RECOMMEND FROM ( SELECT RJ.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RJ.MB_ID, RJ.MBP_ID ORDER BY RJ.RECOMMEND) AS RN FROM RECOMMEND_JOIN RJ ) WHERE RN <= 100 ), MATCHED_DRUGS AS ( SELECT L.MB_ID, L.MBP_ID, L.RECOMMEND, D.DR_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY L.RECOMMEND ORDER BY D.DR_ID) AS DRUG_RN FROM LIMITED_RECOMMEND L JOIN DRUG_TB D ON DBMS_LOB.INSTR(D.DR_MAIN_FUNCTION, L.RECOMMEND) > 0 ) SELECT * FROM DRUG_TB WHERE DR_ID IN ( SELECT DR_ID FROM MATCHED_DRUGS WHERE DRUG_RN <= #{resultScore} ) ORDER BY DR_ID
SELECT MBS_ID , MBS_SCORE , MBS_SERVEY_DATE FROM MEMBER_SURVEY_TB WHERE MB_ID = #{sessionID} ORDER BY MBS_SERVEY_DATE DESC

SELECT MB_ID, MBS_SCORE, SUBSTR(MB_NAME, 1, 1) || '**' AS MB_NAME, MBS_SERVEY_DATE FROM ( SELECT t.*, ROWNUM rnum FROM ( SELECT mst.MB_ID AS MB_ID, mst.MBS_SCORE AS MBS_SCORE, mt.MB_NAME AS MB_NAME, mst.MBS_SERVEY_DATE AS MBS_SERVEY_DATE FROM MEMBER_SURVEY_TB mst JOIN MEMBER_TB mt ON mst.MB_ID = mt.MB_ID ORDER BY mst.MBS_SERVEY_DATE DESC ) t WHERE ROWNUM <= 10 ) ORDER BY rnum
